discovery.title: A hidden ice boundary may change Thwaites Glacier’s sea-level outlook
discovery.summary: A new model that accounts for seawater moving beneath grounded ice matched historical satellite observations four times more closely than models that omit this zone. Some simulations project up to twice the glacier’s previously estimated contribution by century’s end.
discovery.why_it_matters: Better glacier models can change how coastal communities assess long-term sea-level risk, though this study refines projections rather than predicting a single outcome.

discovery.title: Could moving match times beat moving a tournament date in extreme heat?
discovery.summary: A new research framework assessed safe playing time under hot conditions. Its summary reported that shifting event hours had a stronger effect on available lower-risk play than changing tournament dates.
discovery.why_it_matters: Heat-aware scheduling can affect athlete safety, spectator comfort, travel plans, and the economics of live events as hot conditions challenge sports calendars.

discovery.summary: A recent report describes Webb observations of a very early-universe supernova, offering a chance to study how massive stars exploded when the cosmos was young.
discovery.why_it_matters: Observations of distant explosions let astronomers investigate stellar evolution and the conditions of the early universe using light that has traveled for billions of years.

discovery.title: Tonight, Earth crosses dust left behind by Halley’s Comet
discovery.summary: The Orionid meteor shower peaks overnight October 21–22. Under dark skies, observers may see about 10–20 meteors an hour; the particles come from Halley’s Comet.
discovery.why_it_matters: A comet that won’t return to view until 2061 still leaves debris that lights up our sky each year.
